title: Google Maps
subtitle: Pre-draw the map, pre-compute the shortcuts
motto: A map request should be a file fetch, and a route request should be a table lookup
coreAddition: pre-rendered tiles behind a CDN and contraction-hierarchy routing
keyInsight: A cache protects the origin only while its contents stay valid, and vector tiles keep the cache valid through a restyle by moving the drawing to the phone.

decisions.title: Break the cache with data, not with a spike
decisions.description: The failure frame combines 10x traffic with a restyle that invalidates raster tiles, to show that a cache fails when its contents go stale as well as when load grows.
decisions.alternatives: A plain traffic spike with the hit rate unchanged would repeat the lesson of the video chapter.

decisions.title: Price the vector tile against client CPU
decisions.description: The trade-off frame reports smaller tiles and a stable hit rate next to the drawing time per phone, since the work moves to the device.
decisions.alternatives: Pre-warming the CDN before a restyle keeps raster tiles and their simple clients but needs an operator step for every change.
